summary: Not sure if this works in the UK but have you looked at buying a book for the kindle and then purchasing the whispersync. It is usually way cheaper than buying the audiobook. Could never figure out how that business model works but now I think I get it. Amazon is extracting basically the difference between the one book and the two book plan/
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Not sure if this works in the UK but have you looked at buying a book for the kindle and then purchasing the whispersync. It is usually way cheaper than buying the audiobook.

Could never figure out how that business model works but now I think I get it. Amazon is extracting basically the difference between the one book and the two book plan/
